root_cause: Protected source SQL migration 20261117123000 applied to native original production by the canonical delivery workflow, while main supabase/migration-history.lock.json still recorded only 878 provider entries. Adding a new pending migration while editing the lock in same PR violated fail-closed native history review.
fix: Reconcile only the exact independently provider-applied migration identity as a separate protected lock-only PR. Never predeclare the pending Guardian v3 version; run its own protected PR after source lock parity is restored.
prevention_rule: Canonical deployment must reconcile provider migration history to Git source via a separately protected accurate change before releasing a new pending migration. Keep original source and exact ref; never waive checks or forge production-applied IDs.
